provenance.price_basis: ERCOT DAM settlement-point prices, hourly, each site at its own load zone (README V3). Not flat.

free_axes.note: lcoc = infra_per_year/(compute_unit_hours*gpu_count) + capex_per_gpu*crf(rate, life)/compute_unit_hours, where gpu_count = it_nameplate_mw*1000/kw_per_gpu. it_nameplate_mw is NOT free -- it changes the physics, not just the arithmetic.

dallas.note: A big-city site in north Texas: less sun than the west of the state, but a stronger local grid.

west_texas.note: Oil country in west Texas: much more sun, but so many solar farms have been built there that midday power is now nearly worthless.
